patterns.note: Full-width sections with generous vertical spacing, often featuring full-bleed imagery or video backgrounds to create immersive visual breaks.
Content sections frequently employ a split layout, pairing a prominent image or video with a concise text block, or organizing information into a grid of smaller, visually distinct cards.
A deep, dark blue/black (`#1f2426`) serves as a dominant background for the header, footer, and key content sections, providing a sophisticated backdrop for white text and a vibrant teal accent.
Headings are set in a strong, modern sans-serif font, providing clear visual hierarchy and a contemporary feel, contrasting with a highly readable sans-serif for body text.
The hero section features a full-width video background that plays automatically, creating an engaging and dynamic initial experience as it scrolls out of view.

The primary navigation bar is sticky, transitioning from a transparent overlay on the hero video to a solid, opaque dark blue background with a subtle drop shadow once the user scrolls past the hero section.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video background that plays on loop, creating an immediate, immersive brand experience. This video is positioned to scroll out of the viewport as the user navigates down the page.

The main navigation bar employs a sticky positioning strategy, initially appearing as a transparent overlay. Upon scrolling, it dynamically transforms into a solid, dark-colored bar, ensuring persistent access to navigation links.

Content sections are visually delineated through distinct background colors (dark, white, or a light blue tint) and generous vertical padding, creating clear thematic breaks as the user scrolls through the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clear hierarchy, paired with standard, readable sans-serif body text for content.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are consistently applied to images, cards, and buttons, contributing to a refined and approachable aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing between major sections, balanced spacing within content blocks, creating a sense of openness and clarity across the page.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-bleed, autoplaying video hero immediately establishes a dynamic and modern brand presence, setting a high-tech and immersive tone against a sophisticated dark theme. This combines corporate authority with a sleek, engaging user experience.
